_description: Ground-truth classification of the 100 fixed eval seeds (900000-900099), built from two sources: (1) direct empirical wins across all 22 project runs + run 021's full 40-checkpoint history (a win is itself proof of solvability, no solver needed), and (2) the ShootMe/Klondike-Solver ground-truth check (agent/klondike_solver_check.py) run against the 28 seeds nothing ever won. The 7 seeds that didn't resolve within the solver's 3,000,000-state search cap are bucketed separately from the 1 proven-unsolvable seed, since they carry different epistemic status (proven-impossible vs merely-unresolved-and-likely-long), but both buckets are treated as excluded for practical purposes given our agent's 1000-step episode cap.

solvable_by_win.note: won by at least one checkpoint across all runs; solvability is a direct empirical fact, not solver-derived

solvable_by_solver.note: never won by any trained checkpoint, but proven solvable by the ground-truth solver - real, currently-unmet capability gaps, not dead seeds

unsolvable.note: proven unsolvable - the solver exhausted its search space (Impossible, max foundation 8 at 81 moves) without finding a solution

excluded_inconclusive.note: solver hit its 3,000,000-state cap without resolving either way; proving impossibility costs far more than finding a solution, so these remain unresolved rather than unsolvable. Treated as excluded for practical purposes (per user direction) given our agent's 1000-step episode cap - if solvable at all, likely requires a long solution unlikely to be found reliably within that budget.
